chapter_title.ar: باب فِيهِ نُكَتٌ وَ نُتَفٌ مِنَ التَّنْزِيلِ فِي الْوَلَايَةِ
chapter_title.en: Chapter 108 – Points and pickings from the Revelation regarding the Wilayah

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (5/122)

chunks.arabic_text: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْجَوْهَرِيِّ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ

translations.bn: আলী ইবন ইব্রাহিম, তাঁর পিতা থেকে, আল-কাসিম ইবন মুহাম্মদ আল-জাওহারি থেকে, তাঁর কিছু সঙ্গী থেকে, আবু আবদুল্লাহ عليه السلام থেকে।
translations.de: Ali ibn Ibrahim, von seinem Vater, von Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari, von einigen seiner Gefährten, von Abu Abdullah عليه السلام.
translations.en: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام.
translations.es: Ali ibn Ibrahim, de su padre, de Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari, de algunos de sus compañeros, de Abu Abdullah عليه السلام.
translations.fa: علی بن ابراهیم، از پدرش، از القاسم بن محمد الجوهری، از برخی از یارانش، از ابو عبدالله علیه السلام.
translations.fr: Ali ibn Ibrahim, de son père, d’Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari, de certains de ses compagnons, d’Abu Abdullah عليه السلام.
translations.id: Ali ibn Ibrahim, dari ayahnya, dari Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari, dari sebagian sahabatnya, dari Abu Abdullah عليه السلام.
translations.ru: Али ибн Ибрахим, от своего отца, от Аль-Касима ибн Мухаммада Аль-Джаухари, от некоторых его сподвижников, от Абу Абдуллаха عليه السلام.
translations.tr: Ali ibn Ibrahim, babasından, Al-Kasim ibn Muhammed el-Cevheri'den, bazı arkadaşlarından, Ebu Abdullah عليه السلام'dan.
translations.ur: علی بن ابراہیم، ان کے والد سے، القاسم بن محمد الجوہری سے، ان کے بعض اصحاب سے، ابو عبداللہ علیہ السلام سے۔
translations.zh: 阿里伊本易卜拉欣，传自其父，传自阿勒卡西姆伊本穆罕默德阿勒焦赫里，传自他的一些同伴，传自阿布杜拉 عليه السلام。

translations.ur: اس کے قول کے بارے میں:

translations.bn: আর তারা তোমাকে জিজ্ঞেস করে তাদেরকে জানাতে: এটা কি সত্য?
translations.de: Und sie bitten dich, ihnen mitzuteilen: Ist es wahr?
translations.en: And they ask you to inform them: Is it true?
translations.es: Y te piden que les informes: ¿Es verdad?
translations.fa: و از تو می‌خواهند که به آنان خبر دهی: آیا این حق است؟
translations.fr: Et ils te demandent de les informer : Est-ce vrai ?
translations.id: Dan mereka meminta engkau memberi tahu mereka: Apakah itu benar?
translations.ru: И они просят тебя сообщить им: правда ли это?
translations.tr: Ve senden onlara haber vermeni isterler: Bu hak mıdır?
translations.ur: اور وہ تم سے پوچھتے ہیں کہ انہیں خبر دو: کیا یہ حق ہے؟
translations.zh: 他们向你询问，要你告诉他们：这是真的吗？

translations.bn: তিনি عليه السلام বললেন: "আলী عليه السلام সম্পর্কে যা বলা হচ্ছে।"
translations.de: Er عليه السلام sagte: „Das, was über Ali عليه السلام gesagt wird.“
translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "What is being said regarding Ali عليه السلام."
translations.es: Él عليه السلام dijo: «Lo que se dice acerca de Ali عليه السلام.»
translations.fa: او علیه السلام فرمود: «آنچه دربارهٔ علی علیه السلام گفته می‌شود.»
translations.fr: Il عليه السلام dit : « Ce qui est dit au sujet de Ali عليه السلام. »
translations.id: Beliau عليه السلام bersabda: "Apa yang dikatakan tentang Ali عليه السلام."
translations.ru: Он عليه السلام сказал: «То, что говорится об Али عليه السلام».
translations.tr: O عليه السلام şöyle dedi: "Ali عليه السلام hakkında söylenen şey."
translations.ur: انہوں نے علیہ السلام فرمایا: "علی علیہ السلام کے بارے میں جو کہا جا رہا ہے۔"
translations.zh: 他 عليه السلام说：“关于阿里 عليه السلام所说的。”

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْ إِي وَرَبِّي إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ

translations.bn: বলুন: হ্যাঁ, আমার রবের কসম, নিশ্চয়ই তা সত্য, এবং তোমরা অক্ষম করতে পারবে না।
translations.de: Sprich: Ja, bei meinem Herrn, es ist gewiss die Wahrheit, und ihr werdet nicht entkommen können.
translations.en: Say: Yes, by my Lord, it is surely the truth, and you will not escape.
translations.es: Di: Sí, por mi Señor, ciertamente es la verdad, y no podréis escapar.
translations.fa: بگو: آری، سوگند به پروردگارم، بی‌گمان آن حق است، و شما ناتوان‌کننده نخواهید بود.
translations.fr: Dis : Oui, par mon Seigneur, c’est certes la vérité, et vous ne pourrez pas échapper.
translations.id: Katakanlah: Ya, demi Tuhanku, sesungguhnya itu benar, dan kamu tidak akan dapat lolos.
translations.ru: Скажи: Да, клянусь моим Господом, это, несомненно, истина, и вы не сможете избежать.
translations.tr: De ki: Evet, Rabbime andolsun ki o mutlaka haktır ve siz aciz bırakamazsınız.
translations.ur: کہہ دو: ہاں، میرے رب کی قسم، یہ یقیناً حق ہے، اور تم عاجز نہیں کر سکتے۔
translations.zh: 你说：是的，指我的主发誓，这确是真实的，而你们绝不能逃脱。

seo_questions.bn: শিয়া হাদিসে কুরআন ১০:৫৩-কে ইমাম আলী عليه السلام সম্পর্কে কীভাবে ব্যাখ্যা করা হয়েছে?
seo_questions.de: Wie wird Qur'an 10:53 in schiitischen Hadithen in Bezug auf Imam Ali عليه السلام ausgelegt?
seo_questions.en: How is Qur'an 10:53 interpreted in Shia hadith regarding Imam Ali عليه السلام?
seo_questions.es: ¿Cómo se interpreta el Corán 10:53 en el hadiz chií respecto al Imam Ali عليه السلام?
seo_questions.fa: آیه ۱۰:۵۳ قرآن در حدیث شیعه دربارهٔ امام علی علیه السلام چگونه تفسیر شده است؟
seo_questions.fr: Comment le Coran 10:53 est-il interprété dans le hadith chiite au sujet de l’Imam Ali عليه السلام ?
seo_questions.id: Bagaimana Qur'an 10:53 ditafsirkan dalam hadis Syiah tentang Imam Ali عليه السلام?
seo_questions.ru: Как в шиитском хадисе толкуется Коран 10:53 в отношении имама Али عليه السلام?
seo_questions.tr: Şii hadiste Kur'an 10:53, İmam Ali عليه السلام hakkında nasıl yorumlanır?
seo_questions.ur: شیعہ حدیث میں قرآن 10:53 کی امام علی علیہ السلام کے بارے میں کیسے تفسیر کی گئی ہے؟
seo_questions.zh: 什叶派圣训中如何将《古兰经》10:53解释为关于伊玛目阿里 عليه السلام？

summaries.bn: এই বর্ণনাটি আয়াতের ব্যাখ্যাকে আমীরুল মুমিনীন আলী عليه السلام এবং তাঁর ওয়িলায়াতের সত্যতার সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত করে। এটি কুরআনিক ঘোষণাকে একটি চূড়ান্ত ঘোষণা হিসেবে উপস্থাপন করে যে এই বিষয়টি সত্য এবং তা এড়ানো বা ব্যর্থ করা যাবে না।
summaries.de: Diese Überlieferung versteht den Vers als Hinweis auf die Wahrheit von Amir al-Mu'minin Ali عليه السلام und seiner wilayah. Sie stellt die koranische Bekräftigung als eine entscheidende Erklärung dar, dass diese Angelegenheit wahr ist und weder umgangen noch vereitelt werden kann.
summaries.en: This narration presents an interpretation of the verse as referring to the truth of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali عليه السلام and his wilayah. It frames the Qur'anic affirmation as a decisive declaration that this matter is true and cannot be evaded or frustrated.
summaries.es: Esta narración presenta una interpretación del versículo como referida a la verdad de Amir al-Mu'minin Ali عليه السلام y su wilayah. Presenta la afirmación coránica como una declaración निर्णente de que este asunto es verdadero y no puede ser eludido ni frustrado.
summaries.fa: این روایت، تفسیر آیه را به حق بودنِ امیرالمؤمنین علی علیه السلام و ولایت او مربوط می‌سازد. این تأیید قرآنی را اعلامی قاطع معرفی می‌کند که این امر حق است و نمی‌توان از آن گریخت یا آن را ناکام ساخت.
summaries.fr: Ce récit présente une interprétation du verset comme renvoyant à la vérité de Amir al-Mu'minin Ali عليه السلام et à sa wilayah. Il présente l’affirmation coranique comme une déclaration décisive selon laquelle cette affaire est vraie et ne peut être éludée ni réduite à néant.
summaries.id: Riwayat ini menafsirkan ayat tersebut sebagai merujuk pada kebenaran Amir al-Mu'minin Ali عليه السلام dan wilayahnya. Ia menampilkan penegasan Al-Qur'an sebagai pernyataan tegas bahwa perkara ini benar dan tidak dapat dihindari atau digagalkan.
summaries.ru: Этот хадис представляет толкование аята как относящееся к истинности Амира аль-му'минина Али عليه السلام и его вилаята. Он представляет кораническое утверждение как решительное заявление о том, что это дело истинно и его нельзя ни обойти, ни сорвать.
summaries.tr: Bu rivayet, ayetin tefsirini Emirü'l-Mü'minin Ali عليه السلام ve onun velayeti'nin hak oluşuna bağlar. Kur'ânî tasdiki, bu meselenin hak olduğuna ve ondan kaçınılamayacağına ya da onun boşa çıkarılamayacağına dair kesin bir ilan olarak sunar.
summaries.ur: یہ روایت آیت کی تفسیر کو امیرالمؤمنین علی علیہ السلام اور ان کی ولایت کے حق ہونے سے مربوط کرتی ہے۔ یہ قرآنی تصدیق کو ایک فیصلہ کن اعلان کے طور پر پیش کرتی ہے کہ یہ امر حق ہے اور اسے ٹالا یا ناکام نہیں بنایا جا سکتا۔
summaries.zh: 这段传述将该节经文解释为指向阿米尔·穆民宁阿里 عليه السلام及其wilayah的真实性。它把《古兰经》的肯定呈现为一个决定性的宣告：此事确是真实的，且无法被回避或挫败。

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (5/122)
text: وَ يَسْتَنْبِئُونَكَ أَ حَقٌّ هُوَ قَالَ مَا تَقُولُ فِي عَلِيٍّ قُلْ إِي وَ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ وَ ما أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ .

en.hubeali: Alli Bin Ibrahim, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad Al Jowharey, from some of his companions,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding Hisazwj Words [10:53] And they are asking you: Is it true? Heasws said: ‘What yousaww are saying regarding Aliasws’. Say: Yes! By my Lord! It is most surely the Truth, and you will not be escaping it’.
en.sarwar: 87. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from from Salma ibn al-Khattab from al-Hassan ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from Ali ibn abu Hamza from abu Basir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious. “When Our clear revelations are recited to them, the unbelievers say to the faithful ones, “Which of us has a better position and is more prosperous?” [19:73] The Imam (a.s.) said, “the Messenger of Allah asked Quraysh (the powerful tribe in Makka) to acknowledge our (Wilaya Leadership with Divine Authority) they turned away and refused. The unbelievers of Quraysh told the true believers of Quraysh (those who acknowledged our Wilaya (Leadership with Divine Authority), “Which group of us has a better position and is more prosperous?” This was to humiliated the true believers. Allah in rebuttal said, “How many generations (people of the past) of greater prosperity and splendor have We destroyed before them?” [19:74] I then asked the meaning of, “(Muhammad), tell them, “The Beneficent God gives respite to those who have gone astray. . [19:75]. The Imam (a.s.) said, “All them lived a life in error and did acknowledge Wilaya (Leadership with Divine Authority of Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) and our Wilaya). They lived in error and lead others to error. Allah gives them time in their error and rebellion until they die. He then cuases them to have the worst of dwelling and be of the weakest parties.” I then asked him about the meaning of, “. . until they face the torment with which they were threatened or to the Day of Judgment. Then they will find out who will have the most miserable place and the weakest forces.” [19:75] The Imam (a.s.) said, “. . until they face the torment with which they were threatened. .” is the time of the rise of al-Mahdi with Divine Authority. That is the time when they will find out what Allah will sent to them through the hands of al-Mahdi (a.s.) and thus, are His words, “. . who will have the most miserable place (at the time of the rise of al-Mahdi with Divine Authority) and the weakest forces.” [19:75] ).” I then asked about the words of Allah. “. . God further enlightens those who seek guidance. ..” [19:76] The Imam (a.s.) said, “Allah will grant them more guidance and certainty to follow Al-Qa’im (the one who will rise with Divine Authority) so that they will not reject or refuse his authority.” I then asked about the words of Allah. “. . no one will be able to intercede for the others except those whom the Beneficent God has given authority.” [19:87] The Imam (a.s.) said, “The acknowledgment of Wilaya (Leadership with Divine Authority) of Amir al-Mu’minin Ali and the Imams after him is part of the religion of Allah (a.s.) and this is the authority and the covenant before Allah.” I then asked about the words of Allah. “To the righteously striving believers God will grant love.” [19:96] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It is the love for Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) and to acknowledge his Wilaya. It is this love of which Allah speaks in His words. “(Muhammad), We have given it to you (the Book, the Quran) in your own language so that you could easily give the glad news to the pious ones and warn the quarrelsome ones.” [19:97]. The Imam (a.s.) said, “It was made easy for him when Allah appointed Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) as the standard of truth. With him He gave glad news to the true believers and warning to the unbelievers. It is these unbelievers whom He has called “the quarrelsome ones” The narrator has said that I then asked him about the words of Allah. “. . so that you may warn a people who are unaware because their fathers were not warned [36:6].The Imam (a.s.) said, “It was to warn the people with whom The Holy Prophet (s.a) lived just as their forefathers were warned and they were unaware of Allah, His messenger and His warning. “. . (I swear) that most of them are doomed to be punished (for not acknowledging the Wilaya of Ali and the Imams after him (a.s.)) They have no faith (in the Wilaya of Ali and the executors of the will after him (a.s.).” [36:7] since they did not believe and their punishment was as such as Allah has mentioned, “. . We have enchained their necks up to their chins. Thus, they cannot bend their heads (in Hell) (to find their way) [36:8].(Then Allah has said, “. . We have set-up a barrier in front of and behind them and have made them blind. Thus, they cannot see.. .” [36:10] (It will be the punishment for not acknowledging the Wilaya of Ali and the Imams after him. This is in this world and in the nest life it will be Hell wherein they will not be able to raise their heard. Then Allah has said, “. . Whether you warn them or not, they will not believe.” [36:10] (in Allah and the Wilaya of Ali and the Imams after him (a.s.) Then Allah has said, “. . You should only warn those who follow the Quran (and Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.)) and have fear of the Beneficent God without seeing Him. Give them (O Muhammad), the glad news of their receiving forgiveness and an honorable reward (from God).” [36:11]”
